plain: The textbook “plus or minus” error bar for a share; simple, but unreliable with few items or rates near 0 or 1.
eli5: The quick “give or take” that sometimes says less than none or more than all.
technical: p̂ ± z√(p̂(1 − p̂)/n), from the normal approximation with the SE evaluated at p̂. Coverage oscillates and falls well below nominal for small n or extreme p (Brown, Cai and DasGupta 2001); it collapses to a point at p̂ = 0 or 1.
